2608.13057.title: TEMPO: Makespan-Aware Expert-Parallel Load Balancing Across Memory- and Compute-Bound Regimes
2608.13057.paper_summary: In expert-parallel (EP) MoE serving, every layer synchronizes at the slowest GPU. Dispatchers balance token counts (EPLB, LPLB, UltraEP) or activated-expert counts (METRO), assuming expert time is linear in one. Measurements on two datacenter GPU generations show it is neither: below $\nstar\!\approx\!156$--$168$ tokens, HBM weight streaming dominates---cost attaches to \emph{activated replicas}, not tokens; above it, grouped GEMM rounds tokens to 128-tile $M$-tiles, so \emph{splitting} an expert adds padded compute. A max-affine profile $t=\max(a+bG,\,c+βN)$ captures both regimes. Realistic decode batches hold hot experts in the linear regime and cold in the flat \emph{simultaneously}; recorded batches show proxy dispatches differ by $1.4$--$1.6\times$ in modeled block time (p95 up to $1.7\times$), and \emph{which} proxy wins flips with the regime. We formalize per-batch dispatch as a fixed-charge makespan problem---NP-hard on two fully replicated GPUs, polynomial in degenerate limits---and present \sys{}, a makespan-aware dispatcher solving it in milliseconds off the critical path; its SGLang integration runs out-of-process and fuses dispatch with count collection into one in-graph kernel. Anchored by an 8-GPU Testbed~A microbenchmark, \sys{} stays within 1\% of the best fixed baseline everywhere and wins by up to $15.5\%$ where regimes mix. End-to-end on Testbed~B, Qwen3-235B (inside the win region) gains $4$--$6\%$ throughput and cuts p99 latency by ${\sim}15.6\%$; DeepSeek-V3 (outside, communication-dominated) shows only mechanism cost. A phase diagram, not a universal win, is the claim: it predicts both outcomes before deployment.
2608.13057.paper_summary_zh: 在專家平行（EP）MoE 服務中，每一層都在最慢的 GPU 上進行同步。調度器平衡令牌數量（EPLB、LPLB、UltraEP）或啟用專家數量（METRO），假設專家的時間在一個範疇內是線性的。對兩個數據中心 GPU 代的測量顯示，實際情況並非如此：在 $\nstar\!\approx\!156$--$168$ 令牌以下，HBM 權重流傳主導——成本附加在 \emph{啟用的副本} 上，而不是令牌；在其以上，分組 GEMM 將令牌四捨五入到 128 瓷磚 $M$-瓷磚，因此 \emph{分割} 一個專家會增加填充計算。一個最大仿射輪廓 $t=\max(a+bG,\,c+βN)$ 捕捉到這兩種情況。現實的解碼批次在線性範疇內保持熱專家，而在平坦的 \emph{同時} 保持冷專家；記錄的批次顯示代理調度在建模區塊時間上差異為 $1.4$--$1.6\times$（p95 高達 $1.7\times$），而 \emph{哪個} 代理獲勝隨著範疇而翻轉。我們將每批調度形式化為固定費用的完工時間問題——在兩個完全複製的 GPU 上是 NP 困難的，在退化極限中是多項式的——並提出 \sys{}，一個在關鍵路徑外以毫秒解決此問題的完工時間感知調度器；其 SGLang 整合在過程外運行，並將調度與計數收集融合為一個圖內內核。由 8-GPU 測試平台~A 的微基準所支撐，\sys{} 在任何地方都保持在最佳固定基線的 1\% 內，並在範疇混合時贏得高達 $15.5\%$ 的優勢。在測試平台~B 上的端到端，Qwen3-235B（位於贏得區域內）獲得 $4$--$6\%$ 的吞吐量增長，並將 p99 延遲減少約 ${\sim}15.6\%$；DeepSeek-V3（位於外部，通信主導）僅顯示機制成本。一個相位圖，而非普遍的勝利，是我們的主張：它在部署之前預測了這兩種結果。
